title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Delimitation of Local Councils Act, 2015.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa except the
areas notified as Cantonment or other areas excluded by Government through
notification in the official Gazette.
(3) It shall come into force on
such date as the Government may by notification in the official Gazette,
specify.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Definitions

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
2. Definitions.---(1) In this Act, unless
there is anything repugnant to the subject or context,-
(a) Commission
means the Election Commission of Pakistan constituted under Article 218 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan;
(b) delimitation means delimitation of village councils, neighbourhood councils, territorial wards of tehsil and district councils, as the case may be, for
elections;
(c) District
means a revenue district notified under the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act,
1967 (W.P. Act No. XVII of 1967);
(d) elections mean elections to local councils in the Province;
(e) Government
means the Government of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa;
(f) Local
Government Act means the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Local
Government Act, 2013 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.
XXVIII of 2013);
(g) Mauza means a revenue estate declared under the West
Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 (W.P. Act XVII of 1967);
(h) population means the population in accordance with the last
preceding population census officially published;
(i) Province means the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa;
(j) rules mean rules made under this Act;
(k) tehsil means a tehsil notified under the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act,
1967 (W.P. Act No. XVII of 1967); and
(l) youth means a duly qualified candidate for elections, who
is below thirty years of age on the last day fixed for filing of nomination
papers.
(2) All words and expressions
used but not defined in this Act shall have the same meanings as assigned to
them in the Local Government Act.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Delimitation by the Commission

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
3. Delimitation by the Commission.---The Commission shall delimit
village councils, neighbourhood councils and
territorial wards for general seats to tehsil and, as
the case may be, district councils in accordance with the provisions of the
Local Government Act.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Procedure of Commission

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
4. Procedure of Commission.--(1) Subject to the provisions of this
Act, the Commission shall regulate its own procedure.
(2) If, upon any matter requiring
decision of the Commission, there is difference of opinion amongst its members,
the opinion of the majority shall prevail and the decision of the Commission
shall be expressed in terms of the opinion of the majority.
(3) The Commission may exercise
its powers and perform its functions notwithstanding that any one of its
members is, for any reason, unable to attend its proceedings and the decision
of at least three members shall have the effect of the decision of the
Commission:
Provided that
where the members attending the proceedings of the Commission are equally
divided in their opinion, the opinion of the Chairman of the Commission shall
prevail and the decision of the Commission shall be expressed in terms of that
opinion.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Delegation of powers, etc

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
5. Delegation of powers, etc.---(1) The
Commission may authorize one or more of its members, acting singly or together,
to exercise and perform all or any of its powers and functions under this Act.
(2) Where two or more members are
authorized under sub-section (1),
(a) their decision shall be expressed in terms of the opinion of
the majority; or
(b) if they are equally divided, the matter shall be placed
before the Chairman of the Commission.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Assistance to the Commission

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
6. Assistance to the Commission.---(1) The Commission, its Chairman
or any officer, authorized in this behalf, may require any person performing
executive functions in connection with the affairs of the Province to perform
such functions or render such assistance in connection with delimitation as it
or he may direct.
(2) All executive authorities of
Government shall assist the Commission in the performance of its functions and
for this purpose the Commission may issue such directions as it may consider
necessary.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Composition and delimitation of district councils

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
7. Composition and delimitation of district councils.---(1)
Each district council shall consist of general seats, seats reserved for women,
peasants and workers, youth and non-muslims as provided in Part-A of SECOND SCHEDULE to the Local Government Act.
(2) For the purposes of election
to the general seats of district council, the Commission shall divide each
district into as many separate territorial wards as the number of general seats
allocated to that district under sub-section (1).

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Composition and delimitation of tehsil councils

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
8. Composition and delimitation of tehsil
councils.---(1) Each tehsil council shall consist
of general seats, seats reserved for women, peasants and workers, youth and
non-muslims as provided in Part-B of SECOND SCHEDULE to the Local Government
Act.
(2) For the purposes of election
to the general seats of tehsil council, the Commission
shall divide each tehsil into as many separate
territorial wards as the number of general seats allocated to that tehsil under sub-section (1).

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Composition of village council and neighbourhood councils

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
9. Composition of village council and neighbourhood
councils.--- Every village council and neighbourhood council, shall be a multimember ward for
election of ten to fifteen following members:
(a) five to ten
members, determined on the basis of population, elected to general seats;
(b) two members elected to seats reserved for women;
(c) one member elected to seat reserved for peasants and
workers;
(d) one member elected to seat reserved for youth; and
(e) one member elected to seat reserved for non-muslims.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Delimitation of village council and neighbourhood council and allocation of seats

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
10. Delimitation of village council and neighbourhood
council and allocation of seats.---(1) A village council shall be an area
comprising one or more muaziaat or, in the case of an
area where revision of settlement under the law has not been taken, one or more
census villages.
(2) In the case of an area with
urban characteristics, a neighbourhood council shall
be an area comprising a whole number of population census blocks as delimited
for the purpose of last preceding census or a combination of whole number of
census blocks and a whole number of muaziaat:
Provided that,
as far as may be,-
(a) the area of a village and neighbourhood
council shall be a territorial unity;
(b) the boundaries of a village and neighbourhood
council shall not cross the limits of a tehsil;
(c) the area of a village council shall comprise a whole number
of patwar circles, or a patwar
circle may contain a number of whole village councils;
(d) the area of
a neighbourhood council shall comprise a whole number
of census blocks as delimited for the purpose of the preceding population
census or a whole number of muaziaat or a combination
of a whole number of census blocks and muaziaat; and
(e) the population of village and neighbourhood
council within a district shall range between two thousand (2,000) to ten
thousand (10,000), calculated on the basis of last preceding population census
officially published:
Provided further
that in a specific case, Commission may in consultation with Government, waive
the aforesaid conditions.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Principles of delimitation

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
11. Principles of delimitation.---(1) The
delimitation shall be carried out in accordance with the following principles:
(a) a village council shall be delimited without distorting the
boundaries of traditional village;
(b) a neighbourhood council shall be delimited without affecting
the unity of census blocks or the combination of census blocks and muaziaat included therein;
(c) general seats in village councils and neighbourhood
councils shall be determined by population of the areas included in these
councils; and
(d) wards for
general seats in tehsil councils and district councils
as far as practicable, be delimited by grouping together geographically
contiguous village councils or, as the case may be, neighbourhood
councils, having regard to existing boundaries of administrative units,
facilities of communications, public convenience and other cognate factors to
ensure homogeneity in the creation of wards.
(2) As far as may be possible,
wards for election to the same local council shall be equal among themselves in
population.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Reports of Commission and list of councils and wards etc

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
12. Reports of Commission and list of councils and wards etc.--(1)
For the purpose of delimiting village councils, neighbourhood
councils and territorial wards of tehsil and district
councils, the Commission may receive and consider representations, hold
inquiries, summon witnesses and record evidence, and shall prepare and publish
in the official Gazette a preliminary report and list of councils and wards
specifying the areas proposed to be included in each village council, neighbourhood council, territorial wards of tehsil councils and territorial wards of district councils
for information of the public and inviting objections, if any.
(2) Any person entitled to vote
at elections in the district may, within ten days of the publication of the
report under sub-section (1), make a representation to the Commission in
respect of delimitation of a village council, neighbourhood
council, ward of tehsil council and district council.
(3) The Commission shall, after
hearing and considering the representations, if any, received by it, make such
amendments, alterations or modifications in the preliminary list published
under sub-section (1), as it thinks fit or necessary, and shall publish in the
official Gazette the final report and list showing the areas included in each
village council, neighbourhood council, ward of tehsil council and district council in the district.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Power of the Commission to make amendment, alteration or modification in the final list

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
13. Power of the Commission to make amendment, alteration or
modification in the final list.--- Notwithstanding anything contained in
this Act, the Commission may, at any time, of its own motion, make such
amendments, alterations or modifications in the final list of village councils,
neighbourhood councils, wards of tehsil
councils and district councils in the Province, as it thinks necessary.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Removal of difficulties

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of

14. Removal of difficulties.---If any difficulty arises in giving
effect to any of the provisions of this Act, the Commission may make such
provision for the removal of the difficulty as it may deem fit.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Bar of jurisdiction

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of
local councils for elections in the Province of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
15. Bar of jurisdiction.---The validity of
delimitation, or of any proceedings taken or anything done by the Commission or
any officer appointed and obligated by it under this Act or rules, shall not be
called in question in any Court.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Delimitation of Local Councils Act 2015
sections.description:
Power to make rules

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA DELIMITATION OF LOCAL COUNCILS ACT, 2015
An
Act to provide for delimitation of

16. Power to make rules.---Government may,
by notification in the official Gazette, make rules for carrying out the
purposes of this Act.
